topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: Just got word that I’m moving to a new department. They’re telling me it’s an opportunity for growth, a chance to broaden my skills. I’ve heard good things about the team over there, and they’ve been working on some really innovative projects. Still, this comes out of the blue. I’m not sure what to make of it. I guess I’ll be packing up my desk and saying goodbye to the folks here. It’s been a great run, but it looks like the next chapter is already starting. I’ll be meeting with my new manager tomorrow to go over the details. Here’s to new beginnings, I suppose.
